latest_release.body:
# Neural Rendering Supermod

## Alpha 0.9.0

All performance figures are compared to v0.8.0

- New DLSS-SR presets K and J (DLSS 4 transformer). Auto now picks K, M or L per mode, like NVIDIA
- New DLSS-NR model CC, 40-80% faster. Requires DLSS-NR 310.9.16 or later
- New DLSS-FG preset C (Lite), 100% faster
- New DLSS-NR Superfast mode for RX 7000 / RX 6000 series: faster than Fast, with a slight brightness shift in some scenes
- DLSS-FG up to x6, with Fixed and Dynamic multipliers
- FSR-FG works with DLSS inputs and DLSS-FG with FSR inputs (x2)
- Faster across all networks: NR up to 23%, SR up to 25%, RR up to 21%
- RX 6000 (RDNA2): DLSS-NR, DLSS-SR and DLSS-RR use a redesigned HIP path
- Upgraded the bundled FSR to 4.1.1 and FSR-FG to 4.0.1
- Added support for driver-upgraded FSR 4.1.2 and FSR-FG 4.0.2
- RX 7000 and RX 9000 now run on D3D12 only: all interop stalls have been eliminated
- Fixed a memory leak: changing settings, presets or resolution no longer makes memory grow
- Reduced the download size by 39% (installer 30.9 MB, was 50.3 MB in 0.8.0)

## DLSS-FG on AMD mod
- Added support for up to x6 MFG, requires a game with Streamline 2.14 or later
- Added support for the new DLSS-FG Lite model (preset C), 100% faster than A and B
- New DLSS-FG multiplier settings: the game's choice, Fixed x2 to x6 or Dynamic (picks the largest multiplier that fits your display's refresh rate)
- 4% performance improvement
- Added a new Fast mode (12% faster than Reference)
- FSR Frame Generation can now be used with DLSS inputs (x2)
- DLSS Frame Generation can now be used with FSR inputs (x2)
- Switching the frame generation provider no longer needs a game restart
- Added software path for PCs without hardware GPU scheduling (HAGS)
- Clearer overlay status: which generator and multiplier are running, what limits them, and whether the frame rate fits your display
- Fixed DLSS-FG stalling on multipliers 4x and above
- Fixed a crash in games that run their own FSR frame generation (Death Stranding 2, Control Resonant) with the mod installed
- The Frame generation tab of the in-game menu now shows correctly in games that only use their own FSR frame generation

## DLSS-NR on AMD mod
- New CC model, 40-80% faster than HT
- 19-23% faster in Fast mode on RX 9000 (HT and CC models)
- 9-14% faster in Reference mode on RX 9000
- 14-19% faster in Fast mode on RX 7000
- 12-17% faster in Reference mode on RX 7000
- New Superfast quality level for RX 7000 / RX 6000 series: 11% faster than Fast on RX 7000. It trades a slight brightness shift in some scenes, e.g. fog can look a little lighter
- On RX 6000 Reference is shown as unavailable: these cards always ran Fast
- When a game re-creates its upscaler (e.g. after a resolution or quality change), NR now starts fresh instead of carrying over the old history, and no longer stops when the new upscaler has no motion vectors
- When NR can't keep up on a slow GPU, the game's own image is shown instead of a black screen

## DLSS-RR on AMD mod
- 11% faster on RX 9000
- 21% faster on RX 7000
- Transparency effects like rain, smoke, lasers and liquids are no longer missing in games that pass them separately (e.g. Cyberpunk)
- Much less stutter when the game changes resolution
- Fixed a VRAM leak when switching upscalers multiple times
- When a game re-creates DLSS-RR, its first frames no longer use the previous session's camera jitter

## DLSS-SR on AMD mod
- Ported models K and J
- 12% faster on RX 9000
- Presets M and L 23-25% faster on RX 7000
- Preset K 13% faster on RX 7000
- No more stutter on the first frame, and much less when the resolution changes

## NeuralHub
- The game page now shows which inputs each game offers (DLSS, FSR, XeSS)
- Faster startup
- Fixed crashes on unusual game files
- Fixed an issue where a failed runtime setup would leave every game silently doing nothing
- Messages and the first-start guide show your configured i

detail.readme:
# DLSS-NR on AMD

Run **DLSS 5 Neural Rendering** on **AMD Radeon RX 9000 (RDNA4), 7000 (RDNA3) and 6000 (RDNA2)** cards, in any DirectX 12 game that uses FSR, DLSS or XeSS.

**NEW IN 0.8.0**: Every main DLSS feature is now fully ported. DLSS Super Resolution, DLSS Ray Reconstruction, DLSS Frame Generation and of course, DLSS Neural Rendering now work on every RDNA4 and RDNA3 GPU. RDNA2 is in testing, supports NR for now, and will receive most of the missing features in the next big release.
FSR Super Resolution is also included, and FSR Frame Generation and Ray Regeneration will be added in an upcoming build.

### Join the [Discord](https://discord.gg/5gCwc6mskc) for support, early access to new mod builds and testing.

## Download

Get `NeuralHub_vX.X.X_setup.exe` from the [latest release](../../releases/latest).

## Install

1. Run `NeuralHub_vX.X.X_setup.exe` and follow the installation steps.
2. Get a copy of `nvngx_dlssnr.dll` (DLSS 5 Neural Rendering, build 310.8.0.0 or later, you can get it from games that support DLSS 5) and import it into NeuralHub.
3. Optionally import `nvngx_dlssg.dll`, `nvngx_dlss.dll`, and `nvngx_dlssd.dll` to use the DLSS-FG, DLSS-SR, and DLSS-RR features. FSR is bundled with the manager and ready to go.
4. Open NeuralHub and let it scan for games.
5. Install the mod loader in every game you'd like and configure the DLSS or FSR features you want.
6. Start the game and **enable DLSS, FSR or XeSS** (any quality / native antialiasing). For now, DLSS Frame Generation requires spoofing and DLSS-FG inputs. Press **End** to open the in-game overlay.

## What to expect

Output quality is very similar to what DLSS produces on the original hardware, though there are still some effects that may not be working 100%.

Performance is now playable: 90-100 FPS at 1080p on an RX 9070 XT, using the full HT model. I'm improving performance every day, goal is to get it to run as fast as a 5070Ti. Check back for new releases.

## In-game overlay

End key to open. Up/Down/Left/Right to adjust, Enter toggles, PgUp/Down for previous/next tab.

## Requirements

- Windows 11, DirectX 12 game with DLSS, FSR or XeSS. Vulkan and Linux support are planned for an upcoming release.
- An AMD Radeon RX 9000, 7000, or 6000 series GPU.
- Installed Adrenalin driver 26.1.1 or later
- Your own copy of the mentioned DLLs
- Games with anti-cheat will block the DLL; use them only with anti-cheat off.

## How can I help?

Two ways:
- Donate. Tokens are expensive, and hardware to test my mods on are even more expensive. Donate here: [ko-fi.com/danielblnc](https://ko-fi.com/danielblnc)
- Test and report. Try on your games, open an issue and attach `dlssnr_on_amd.log` if you encounter any problems. Join the discord for faster communication.

## FAQ

- **Is this a compatibility layer?** No. This is a ground-up, full reimplementation of every DLSS neural network runtime for AMD GPU architectures (HIP kernels, memory layouts, game integration), written from scratch. No NVIDIA code is included or translated at runtime.

## Legal

This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by NVIDIA or AMD. DLSS is a trademark of NVIDIA Corporation, and all credit of the DLSS program goes to them. The software here contains no NVIDIA code or data; it requires the user's own legitimately obtained copy of the DLSS DLLs. Provided as-is, without warranty; use at your own risk.
